_README.oracle_pct: Share of items where SOME arm in the pool answered correctly — a CEILING on any selector, not a score anything achieved. `wall` is its complement: items no arm got.
_README.held_out_pct: The router scored on questions absent from its own route table (5-fold refit of the fingerprint index, router/heldout_test.go) — what a new question actually gets.
_README.best_single_pct: The strongest single arm, over the same items.
